financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Follow-on public offering of common stock including full exercise of underwriters' option; closed October 16, 2023
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Total proceeds of the transaction, including the Option Shares were approximately $92.5 million, net of underwriting discounts and estimated offering expenses. The offering closed on October 16, 2023.

warrants.quote: In June 2022, the Company also issued 10,459,181 warrants with an exercise price of $7.35 and as of September 30, 2023, all remain outstanding.
